description: REQ-001/REQ-002 use non-committal example language ('e.g. 4 poll attempts', no stated settle-delay duration) rather than a firm, testable MUST value. Project convention (CLAUDE.md rule 0.7) explicitly forbids 'optional'/'recommended' framing in specs — everything MUST be concrete. Because the timeout bound and settle-delay are only exemplified, not mandated, PROP-002's own fixture ('a 4-read sequence that never converges') is not actually derived from a REQ-002 MUST value, leaving the exact poll-count/timeout a free implementation choice that the proof-obligation table treats as already fixed.

evidence.snippet: IF the reel-href list does not stabilize within a bounded timeout (e.g. 4 poll attempts), THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL treat the snapshot as inconclusive
